title: Spayee and Learnyst Alternative (2026): Spayee Is Now Graphy
description: Spayee now redirects to Graphy. Learnyst, Graphy, Edmingle, Classplus, Testpress and AllCoaching compared for Indian educators, with prices from each official site.
og_description: Spayee.com now redirects to Graphy, and Learnyst publishes its prices. Here is an honest comparison of the alternatives, with every price dated and sourced, and when staying on Learnyst is the better call.
keywords: course platform with own app and domain
h1: Spayee and Learnyst Alternative in India (2026): Spayee Is Now Graphy, Learnyst Prices Checked
dek: Spayee no longer runs as a separate product, and Learnyst now publishes its plans. This guide compares the real options for educators on either platform, with every competitor price taken from its official site and dated.
cover_alt: Looking for a Spayee or Learnyst alternative: Graphy, Learnyst, Edmingle, Classplus, Testpress and AllCoaching compared, with prices checked on 24 Oct 2026
audience: Indian educators and coaching institutes on Spayee (now Graphy) or Learnyst comparing alternatives
intro: If you are looking for a Spayee alternative, know first that spayee.com now redirects to Graphy, so former Spayee users are effectively on Graphy today; if you are looking for a Learnyst alternative, the right choice depends on whether you need Learnyst's test engine and content protection or want your own website and app at a lower fixed cost. For an educator who wants a website on their own domain and their own Android and iOS app, set up without a sales call, AllCoaching is the closest fit. For test-heavy academies that need DRM video protection, staying on Learnyst or looking at Testpress makes sense.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. Every competitor price below comes from that company's own website, with the link and the date we checked it (24 Oct 2026), and we say where another platform fits better than ours.

Learnyst publishes its prices: Launcher at ₹10,000 a year plus 10% of sales, and subscription plans from ₹8,999 a month (₹8,099 a month billed annually) with 0% transaction fees, taxes extra.[2] Spayee has no separate pricing any more; see Graphy below.
takeaways: spayee.com now redirects to graphy.com (checked 24 Oct 2026). Treat a Spayee account as a Graphy account and compare Graphy's current plans.
Graphy's rupee prices could not be confirmed on 24 Oct 2026, because its pricing page shows prices by country; check graphy.com/pricing from India. It offers a 14-day free trial.
Learnyst Launcher costs ₹10,000 a year + 10% of sales; Professional costs ₹8,999 a month (₹8,099 billed annually) with 0% transaction fees; Premium and Business go up to ₹49,999 a month; taxes extra.
AllCoaching starts at ₹6,999 a year + 10% on sales (Starter), with Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5% and Pro ₹24,999 + 5%; GST extra; 14-day free trial with no card.
On published prices, AllCoaching costs less than Learnyst up to about ₹14.4 lakh of sales a year; above that, Learnyst's 0%-fee Professional plan costs less.
Learnyst and Testpress advertise DRM content protection; AllCoaching does not claim DRM, so if it is essential for you, weigh that first.
You can switch without losing students by running both platforms side by side until current batches finish.

sections.h2: The short answer: pick by what you need
sections.html:
There is no single best Spayee or Learnyst alternative. There is a best fit for each kind of academy, so start from what you want to change.

{{fig:verdict|Which Spayee or Learnyst alternative to choose by need: own website and app built yourself, AllCoaching; mock tests with DRM protection, stay on Learnyst; very high sales on a flat price, Learnyst Professional or Edmingle; former Spayee user happy with the product, Graphy|Pick the row that sounds like you. The rest of this guide explains each choice.}}

The next two sections explain how we compared and why educators on Spayee and Learnyst usually start looking.

sections.h2: How we compared Spayee, Learnyst and the alternatives
sections.html:
We compared Learnyst and Graphy (formerly Spayee) with four options educators often shortlist: AllCoaching, Edmingle, Classplus and Testpress. We looked at five things an academy pays for or depends on.

  1. Price you can see before signing up, taken only from each company's own pricing page.
  2. Fee on your sales, because a percentage changes the total as you grow.
  3. What you own: your domain, your Android and iOS app and the developer account it is published under, and your student data.
  4. Teaching features that matter for exams: test series, live classes and content protection.
  5. How you start: a self-serve trial, or a demo and sales call.
Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: Why educators look for a Spayee or Learnyst alternative
sections.html:
Both platforms have served Indian educators for years, and Learnyst in particular is strong for test series. The reasons educators compare usually fall into three groups.

1. Spayee is now Graphy

When we visited spayee.com on 24 Oct 2026, it redirected to graphy.com.[1] Graphy is the platform built by the Spayee team. If you signed up with Spayee, your plan, prices and support now sit with Graphy, so compare Graphy's current offer, not Spayee's old one.

2. The fixed cost before you earn

Learnyst gives you two shapes of price. Launcher is ₹10,000 a year with 10% of sales and "No monthly fee". Professional is ₹8,999 a month, or ₹8,099 a month billed annually, which is ₹97,188 a year, with 0% transaction fees. The second is strong at high sales and heavy at low sales. Many educators look for something in between.

{{q:Is my Learnyst plan too expensive, or am I just not selling enough yet?|Usually it is about stage. A 0%-fee monthly plan suits an academy with steady, large sales; a plan with a low yearly price and a fee on sales suits one that is still growing. Compare the total at your real sales level, as in the cost section below.}}

3. Who owns the app listing

Learnyst's pricing page says apps "will be available in Google Play store & Apple App store under Learnyst's Developer Account", and a branded Android app starts from the Premium plan. Some educators want their own app on every plan. Ask each platform whose developer account the app is published under.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after: an academy weighing a high monthly plan, app under someone else's developer account and unclear Spayee status, compared with one academy with its own website, Android and iOS app, tests and UPI checkout|Whatever you choose, know what you pay and what you own before you move.}}

Published price
Starter ₹6,999/yr + 10% on sales, Growth ₹12,999/yr + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999/yr + 5%; GST extra.[7]

Check

2. Learnyst (stay)

Good at
Courses, mock tests and live classes with DRM content protection and test series; it offers "features required to market and sell your content online across globe".
Published price
Launcher ₹10,000/yr + 10% of sales; Professional ₹8,999/month (₹8,099/month billed annually), Premium ₹14,999/month (₹13,499), Business ₹49,999/month (₹44,999), all with 0% transaction fees; Enterprise on request; taxes extra.[2]

Check

Best for
Test-series academies that need DRM and sell enough for a 0%-fee plan to pay off.

3. Graphy (formerly Spayee)

Good at

Training businesses and larger institutes with several batches and branches.

₹29,999 for 1 year and ₹39,999 for 2 years.[5]
Free trial

Coaching institutes with steady sales that prefer one flat yearly price.

Online exam and LMS software for institutes, with DRM video streaming and AI proctoring; it covers exams "From NEET and JEE to internal corporate assessments".

Check
The yearly cost, any fee on sales, and who owns the app listing.
Best for
Large exam institutes that need proctored tests and protected video.

sections.h2: What each option really costs as you grow
sections.html:
A yearly price only tells half the story when a platform also takes a percentage. The chart adds each published plan price to its published fee at five sales levels and picks the lowest-cost plan each time. Graphy is not in the chart because we could not confirm its rupee prices, and Testpress does not list prices.

{{fig:cost|Total yearly cost at sales levels up to ₹10 lakh from published prices for AllCoaching, Learnyst, Edmingle and Classplus|Before GST and taxes. Edmingle's and Classplus's lines are listed prices only, because their pricing pages do not state a fee on sales.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: Learnyst's Launcher plan costs ₹3,001 a year more than AllCoaching Starter at every sales level, because both take 10% and the yearly price differs. Learnyst's 0%-fee Professional plan (₹97,188 a year billed annually) costs less than AllCoaching above about ₹14.4 lakh of sales a year. Classplus's flat listed price is lower on paper above about ₹2.3 lakh a year, and Edmingle Core above about ₹13 lakh, provided each confirms there is no fee on sales. Use our plan finder to run your own numbers.

{{cta}}

Former Spayee user

You are already on Graphy. If the product works, the simplest step is to confirm your current plan and rupee price with Graphy. If you want your own domain and app on every plan, compare with the options above. Our guide to an LMS with a custom domain explains what to check.

Test-series academy (SSC, banking, NEET, JEE)

If mocks are your main product and DRM matters, Learnyst is hard to beat, and Testpress is worth a demo. If you mainly need a clean test series with your own app, see best platform for selling PDF notes and test series and how to create mock tests online.

Growing academy (under ₹10 lakh a year)

A low yearly price with a fee on sales usually costs less than a high monthly plan at this stage. Compare the totals in the cost section, not the headline numbers. Our LMS pricing guide goes deeper.

Training business with branches

Edmingle is built for batches and branches. Compare it with the best LMS options for coaching institutes.

sections.h2: How to switch from Spayee or Learnyst without losing students
sections.html:
The safe way to switch is to run both platforms side by side. Current students keep access on the old platform until their batch or validity ends; new admissions go to your new academy.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to switch from Spayee or Learnyst: build your academy, run both side by side, move new admissions, close the old plan after the last batch|Nobody loses access, and nobody pays twice.}} {{steps}}

The full checklist, including messages to send students, is in how to switch coaching apps without losing students.

items: Download your videos, PDFs, question banks and student list from Learnyst or Graphy before you start.
Start the 14-day trial, connect your domain and rebuild one complete course and one test series.
Run both platforms side by side
Keep current students on the old platform until their batch or course validity ends.
Send new admissions to your academy
Share your own website and app link on YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp for every new batch.
Close the old plan at renewal
Let the old plan end at its renewal date, after the last batch finishes.

faq: What is the best Spayee or Learnyst alternative in India?

It depends on what you need. AllCoaching fits educators who want their own website and Android and iOS app built themselves, from ₹6,999 a year plus a fee on sales. Learnyst stays strong for DRM-protected test series, Edmingle suits training businesses, Classplus suits institutes that prefer a flat yearly price, and former Spayee users can stay on Graphy.

Not as a separate product. On 24 Oct 2026, spayee.com redirected to graphy.com, the platform built by the Spayee team, so treat a Spayee account as a Graphy account and compare Graphy's current plans.
How much does Learnyst cost in 2026?

Learnyst lists Launcher at ₹10,000 a year plus 10% of sales, Professional at ₹8,999 a month (₹8,099 billed annually), Premium at ₹14,999 a month and Business at ₹49,999 a month, with 0% transaction fees on the subscription plans and taxes extra (learnyst.com/pricing, checked 24 Oct 2026).
Is there a Learnyst alternative with no monthly fee?
Yes. AllCoaching has one annual plan from ₹6,999 a year plus 10% on sales, with no monthly bill. Learnyst's own Launcher plan also has no monthly fee, at ₹10,000 a year plus 10% of sales.
On published prices, yes up to about ₹14.4 lakh of sales a year. Above that, Learnyst's 0%-fee Professional plan, ₹97,188 a year billed annually, costs less than AllCoaching Pro.
Does AllCoaching offer DRM content protection like Learnyst?
AllCoaching does not claim DRM content protection. Learnyst and Testpress both advertise it, so if DRM is essential for your content, compare those platforms first.
Can I move my courses and students from Spayee or Learnyst?

Yes. Export your content and student list, build your new academy during the 14-day trial, keep current students on the old platform until their batch ends, and send new admissions to your own website and app.
Do Spayee or Learnyst alternatives bring students?

Most are tools, so finding students stays your job. AllCoaching also lists your courses on the AllCoaching marketplace app, which helps discovery, but your own website, YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp remain the main ways students find you.
